subject: Biotechnology
title: Therapeutic Vaccines
description: A micro-lesson that makes Therapeutic Vaccines usable.

hook.text: Most vaccines prevent disease — therapeutic vaccines treat diseases you already have. They retrain your immunity.

buildup.text: Sipuleucel-T treats prostate cancer — patient's own immune cells are exposed to a tumor antigen and reinfused.

discovery.text: Therapeutic hepatitis B vaccines aim to cure chronic infection — awakening exhausted T cells that ignore the virus.

twist.text: The immune system actively suppresses responses to chronic infections — breaking tolerance is the hardest challenge.

climax.text: Alzheimer's vaccines targeting amyloid plaques entered trials — immunotherapy expanding beyond infectious disease.

punchline.text: Not prevention but cure — therapeutic vaccines fight what is already there.

quiz.question: What makes therapeutic vaccines different from preventive vaccines?
options: They use stronger adjuvants than preventive vaccines
They treat existing diseases by reactivating the immune response against them
They prevent diseases from spreading to other people
